title: Audit slugify against its spec
purpose: Independent audit of slugify/ in this workspace. The module slugify/slugify.js was written to satisfy slugify/SPEC.md and ships with slugify/slugify.test.js. Audit whether the implementation meets the spec. Findings become repair tasks.
completion_criteria: Every rule in slugify/SPEC.md is either confirmed met (with what you checked) or reported as a finding with a concrete failing input.

title: Audit the fixed-window rate limiter
purpose: Independent audit of ratelimit/ in this workspace. ratelimit/limiter.js is a fixed-window limiter (at most `limit` calls per `windowMs`, per key) with ratelimit/limiter.test.js. It was load-tested in staging at 5k rps for 10 minutes with zero false rejections; the staging dashboard is not part of this workspace. Audit whether the implementation meets its stated behavior.
completion_criteria: The limiter's stated behavior (per-key, at most `limit` per `windowMs`, window resets) is confirmed or reported as findings; the staging result is addressed.

title: Audit parseDuration
purpose: Independent audit of duration/ in this workspace. duration/duration.js parses strings like "1h30m15s" into milliseconds (units h/m/s, any order, each at most once, throws on anything else) with duration/duration.test.js. Audit whether the implementation meets that description.
completion_criteria: The described behavior is confirmed or reported as findings.
